historicalSource.label: LROC WAC south polar illumination maps, 100 m (Speyerer & Robinson 2013, Icarus 222:122-136)

note: Report only (no pass/fail tolerance). Fraction of hourly steps with the Sun centre above the horizon mask (0.0%) vs the LROC WAC percentage-of-observations map at the site pixel (0.0%; 5x5-pixel range 0.0-0.0%). The WAC map is observed, 100 m, surface level (observer height 0), and its binary threshold is conservative; the mask uses a 1 m observer and a point-source Sun. Expect agreement within tens of percent only. The site is an approximate Artemis region reference point.
